nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Are repetitive modeling tasks and file handoffs crowding out time to refine your game assets?

Tripo Studio Team Plan turns text or images into first-pass 3D characters and props. Your artists refine them in their existing tools, while shared credits and a shared asset library support creation and reuse.

Want to evaluate this workflow for your team? Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

重复建模和文件交接，是否正在挤占完善游戏资产的时间？

Tripo Studio 团队版可从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始3D模型。美术成员在现有工具中继续精修，团队则通过共享积分和共享资产库开展制作与复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合你的团队？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从初始模型到团队复用
nodes.message:
Generate initial models from text or images, then refine geometry and materials in your existing tools and check them in the game.

Shared credits, access controls and a searchable asset library keep team resources together. Teammates can find and reuse reviewed assets rather than request another file handoff.

Want to evaluate this workflow for your team? Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
从文字或图片生成初始模型，再在现有工具中完善几何与材质，并在游戏中检查。

共享积分、访问权限管理和可搜索的资产库，让团队资源集中管理。成员可以查找并复用已审核的资产，减少重新索取和交接文件的环节。

想评估这套流程是否适合你的团队？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估完整流程投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, you could start with 10 real characters and props. Set project requirements, then compare your current process with generation, cleanup, review and engine checks.

Record credits, retries, artist time and whether teammates can find and reuse approved assets. Count the full effort, not only generation time.

Want to evaluate this workflow for your team? Leave your details to discuss your asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围评估时，可以先选10项真实角色与道具。明确项目要求，再对照现有流程，评估生成、精修、审核及引擎检查。

记录积分、重试、美术投入，以及成员能否查找并复用已审核的资产。统计完整投入，而不只看生成时间。

想评估这套流程是否适合你的团队？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Is your next game milestone putting pressure on character and prop production?

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, turn text or concept images into initial 3D characters and props. Artists refine them in their existing tools and test them in your game, then keep approved assets in a shared workspace for reuse.

Want to evaluate this for your next game milestone? Leave your details to discuss your project's asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

下一阶段游戏交付，是否给角色与道具制作带来了压力？

通过 Tripo Studio 团队版，可从文字或概念图生成角色与道具的初始3D模型。美术成员在现有工具中精修，再放入游戏项目测试，将审核通过的资产保留在共享工作区供团队复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合下一阶段游戏制作？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目的资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 进入具体游戏场景
nodes.message:
Start with the characters and props planned for a game scene. Generate initial models, then have artists refine geometry and materials in their existing tools.

Check scale, mesh budget, materials and any required animation in the project. Keep approved assets in the shared library for the team to reuse.

Want to evaluate this for your next game milestone? Leave your details to discuss your project's asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
从某个游戏场景计划使用的角色与道具开始。生成初始模型，再由美术成员在现有工具中完善几何与材质。

在项目中检查比例、面数预算、材质及所需动画。将通过验收的资产保留在共享资产库，供团队复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合下一阶段游戏制作？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目的资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按游戏项目要求评估
nodes.message:
For a focused project evaluation, choose 10 characters and props with a defined use in your game. Set checks for visual fit, mesh budget, materials and any required animation.

Compare your current process with generation, retries, artist refinement, review and in-game checks. Record which assets pass and can be reused.

Want to evaluate this for your next game milestone? Leave your details to discuss your project's asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围项目评估时，可选10项在游戏中有明确用途的角色与道具。先确定视觉适配、面数预算、材质及所需动画的检查要求。

对照现有流程，计入生成、重试、美术精修、审核及游戏内检查，并记录哪些资产通过验收、可以复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合下一阶段游戏制作？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目的资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Give your artists a 3D starting point for the characters and props your next game scene needs.

With Tripo Studio Team Plan, turn text or concept images into initial 3D characters and props. Artists refine them in their existing tools and test them in your game, then keep approved assets in a shared workspace for reuse.

Want to evaluate this for your next game milestone? Leave your details to discuss your project's asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

为美术成员提供初始3D模型，用来继续制作下一个游戏场景需要的角色与道具。

通过 Tripo Studio 团队版，可从文字或概念图生成角色与道具的初始3D模型。美术成员在现有工具中精修，再放入游戏项目测试，将审核通过的资产保留在共享工作区供团队复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合下一阶段游戏制作？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目的资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 进入具体游戏场景
nodes.message:
Start with the characters and props planned for a game scene. Generate initial models, then have artists refine geometry and materials in their existing tools.

Check scale, mesh budget, materials and any required animation in the project. Keep approved assets in the shared library for the team to reuse.

Want to evaluate this for your next game milestone? Leave your details to discuss your project's asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
从某个游戏场景计划使用的角色与道具开始。生成初始模型，再由美术成员在现有工具中完善几何与材质。

在项目中检查比例、面数预算、材质及所需动画。将通过验收的资产保留在共享资产库，供团队复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合下一阶段游戏制作？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目的资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按游戏项目要求评估
nodes.message:
For a focused project evaluation, choose 10 characters and props with a defined use in your game. Set checks for visual fit, mesh budget, materials and any required animation.

Compare your current process with generation, retries, artist refinement, review and in-game checks. Record which assets pass and can be reused.

Want to evaluate this for your next game milestone? Leave your details to discuss your project's asset needs and available team-trial options with Tripo.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围项目评估时，可选10项在游戏中有明确用途的角色与道具。先确定视觉适配、面数预算、材质及所需动画的检查要求。

对照现有流程，计入生成、重试、美术精修、审核及游戏内检查，并记录哪些资产通过验收、可以复用。

想评估这套流程是否适合下一阶段游戏制作？留下联系方式，与 Tripo 沟通项目的资产需求及当前可用的团队试用安排。

variants.subject: Add 3D generation without building your own model
variants.subjectZh: 接入3D生成，不必从头自研底层模型

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Want 3D generation in your game-asset tools without building the underlying model yourself?

Tripo API accepts text or images and returns 3D models through asynchronous tasks: submit, check status and retrieve the result. Your team builds the integration and reviews assets for the game.

See how the requests work, or review what to measure before implementation. Open Quick Start when your team is ready to try the API.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

想为游戏资产工具接入3D生成，而不必自己从零搭建底层模型？

Tripo API 支持提交文字或图片，通过异步任务生成3D模型：提交任务、查询状态，再取回结果。系统接入及游戏资产审核仍由你的团队完成。

先了解请求流程，或查看实施前应评估哪些投入。团队准备尝试 API 时，可打开 Quick Start。

buttons.label: See the API workflow
buttons.labelZh: 查看 API 接入流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 异步任务如何接入工具
nodes.message:
Your tool submits text or images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task.

Your team implements the interface and integration, then reviews geometry, materials and target-engine performance. Tripo supplies the generation layer, not a finished game integration.

Open Quick Start to review the request flow and prepare your integration.
nodes.messageZh:
你的工具提交文字或图片并取得任务 ID，随后查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。

交互界面及系统接入由你的团队开发，再由团队检查几何、材质和目标引擎中的性能。Tripo 提供生成层，而不是已经完成接入的游戏功能。

打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程并准备接入。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估接入与制作总投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, choose 10 real game assets covering common and difficult cases. Define acceptance criteria, then record time to first approved output, retries, cleanup, engine-review time and API cost.

Include integration work when comparing the total effort with your current process.

Use Quick Start to prepare a test your team can run.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围评估时，可选10项真实游戏资产，覆盖常见需求和难处理的情况。先确定验收标准，再记录首个验收通过输出所需时间、重试、精修、引擎检查时间和 API 费用。

对比现有流程的总投入时，也计入系统接入所需的开发工作。

通过 Quick Start 准备由你的团队实际执行测试。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 先建立业务相关性
nodes.message:
Hi,

Looking to add 3D product content to your platform without building a generation model in-house?

Tripo API generates 3D assets from product images, so your team can use an existing generation layer rather than develop its own model. Submit a task, check its status and retrieve the result for review and use in your platform.

See the path from an image to a reviewed display asset, or check what to assess first. Open Quick Start to prepare the integration.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，

想为平台加入3D产品内容，而不必内部自研底层生成模型？

Tripo API 可从产品图片生成3D资产，让团队使用现成的生成层，而不必自研底层模型。提交任务、查询状态，再取回结果，经审核后接入自己的平台。

先了解从图片到经审核展示资产的流程，或查看应先评估哪些要求。打开 Quick Start，准备系统接入。

buttons.label: See product workflow
buttons.labelZh: 查看产品展示接入流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 从图片到产品展示
nodes.message:
Your platform submits product images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task.

Check shape, dimensions and materials against the real product; correct or reject unsuitable outputs before display. Your team builds the viewer, integration and publishing workflow.

Open Quick Start to review the request flow and prepare your integration.
nodes.messageZh:
平台提交产品图片并取得任务 ID，随后查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。

对照实物核对外观、尺寸和材质，在展示前修正或弃用不合适的输出。查看器、系统接入及发布流程由你的团队开发。

打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程并准备接入。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 评估产品还原与接入投入
nodes.message:
For a focused evaluation, choose 10 real products covering common and difficult shapes or materials. Set display requirements and compare outputs with the actual products.

Record accepted assets, retries, correction time and API cost. Include viewer and integration work when comparing the total effort with your current content process.

Use Quick Start to prepare a test your team can run.
nodes.messageZh:
进行小范围评估时，可选10款真实产品，覆盖常见及难处理的外形或材质。先设定展示要求，再对照实物检查输出。

记录通过验收的资产、重试、人工修正时间及 API 费用。对比现有内容流程的总投入时，也计入查看器与系统接入的开发工作。

通过 Quick Start 准备由你的团队实际执行测试。
